Explain in a short self-contained paragraph why a bicycle tyre feels softer on a cold morning, without numbers. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: On a cold morning, the air inside a bicycle tyre contracts and occupies less volume, lowering the pressure. With less internal pressure pushing outward, the tyre feels softer than it does in warmer conditions.
